2609.23152.title: Bearings: Self-Supervised Soundfield Embeddings from First-Order Ambisonics
2609.23152.paper_summary: Recently proposed self-supervised audio encoders learn powerful general-purpose representations of sound scenes, yet they are spatially blind. To supply the missing spatial representation of sound scenes, we introduce Bearings. Bearings is a self-supervised framework that learns soundfield embeddings from unlabeled first-order Ambisonics. We pre-train a masked auto-encoder paired with a decoder conditioned on frozen acoustic embeddings from an off-the-shelf single-channel audio encoder. Our results show that the resulting soundfield embeddings form a reusable stream that can be attached to frozen acoustic encoders with a lightweight trainable fusion head. On sound event localization and detection, concatenating our soundfield embeddings with acoustic representations provides the missing spatial information and enables joint detection and localization, raising the location-dependent F-score from below 4 to 50 on TAU-NIGENS 2021 and 39 on STARSS23. To our knowledge, Bearings is the first self-supervised soundfield encoder whose embeddings plug into frozen acoustic encoders without retraining either model.
2609.23152.paper_summary_zh: 最近提出的自監督音頻編碼器學習了強大的通用聲音場景表示，但它們在空間上是盲目的。為了補充聲音場景缺失的空間表示，我們引入了 Bearings。Bearings 是一個自監督框架，從未標記的一階 Ambisonics 中學習聲場嵌入。我們預訓練了一個掩蔽自動編碼器，並配對一個基於來自現成單通道音頻編碼器的凍結聲學嵌入的解碼器。我們的結果顯示，生成的聲場嵌入形成了一個可重用的流，可以與凍結的聲學編碼器連接，並配備輕量級可訓練的融合頭。在聲音事件定位和檢測中，將我們的聲場嵌入與聲學表示串接提供了缺失的空間信息，並使聯合檢測和定位成為可能，將位置依賴的 F-score 從 4 以下提高到 TAU-NIGENS 2021 的 50 和 STARSS23 的 39。據我們所知，Bearings 是第一個自監督聲場編碼器，其嵌入可以無需重新訓練任何模型而直接插入凍結的聲學編碼器。
